title_zh: 社会服务与人际沟通 — 第17节
body_en: Volunteer work teaches care for others. Serve food, visit elders, clean a park — notice real needs. Ask before you help so your effort matches what people want. Team service needs planning and thanks. Small local acts matter more than big empty slogans.
body_zh: 志愿活动教关心他人。送餐、探望老人、清理公园——看见真实需求。先问再帮，让努力对上对方想要的。团队服务要计划、要感谢。本地的小行动，胜过空洞大口号。
